BayesIRTplot

BayesIRTplot generates plots for Bayesian item response theory (IRT) models fitted in blavaan. The current version supports unidimensional two-parameter IRT models for binary items. Available plots include Item-Person Map (IPM), Item Characteristic Curve (ICC), Item Information Curve (IIC), Test Characteristic Curve (TCC), Test Information Curve (TIC), and Marginal Reliability Plot (REL).

Installation

You can install BayesIRTplot from GitHub:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("BayesIRTplot/BayesIRTplot")

Alternatively, you can use remotes:

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("BayesIRTplot/BayesIRTplot")

Example 

library(BayesIRTplot)
BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model)

# access individual plot
plots <- BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, print_plots = FALSE)
plots$IPMplot
